title: Illinois puts $180K in snowmobile trail grants to two groups
summary: Illinois DNR money from sled registration fees sends $60K to Rockford Park District for trail and bridge work and $120K to the state snowmobile club association for grooming, insurance and signs.

title: Snocross waives race entry fees for first-season racers
summary: Riders who have never raced the national series get free entries at every national event for their whole first season.

title: Season-long test: is the Polaris RMK Khaos Limited Edition worth it?
summary: A full mountain winter on a 2026 Patriot Boost RMK Khaos 155 Limited Edition, whose roughly $1,582 package adds bags, bumpers, skid plate and tunnel bracing. The tester says it paid off.

title: Polaris gives nearly $125K to trail clubs in fall Trails Grants
summary: Thirteen off-road and snowmobile clubs in the U.S. and Canada share the fall round, bringing Polaris's 2026 trail grants past $250,000.

title: Industry launches Go Snowmobiling to bring in new riders
summary: Arctic Cat, BRP, Polaris and clubs back GoSnowmobiling.com, a one-stop site for first-timers looking for rentals, gear, clubs and places to ride.

title: Snocross 2026–27 season opens Dec. 11–12 at Mt. Zion
summary: The national tour starts in Ironwood, Michigan, and runs eight race weekends across the U.S. and Canada before the finale in Duluth.

title: Ski-Doo MXZ X-RS 600RR named 2027 Snowmobile of the Year
summary: Snow Goer's November issue names its pick and top 10 contenders, and also includes a big-bore comparison and a look back at the 1971 Skiroule S-400.

title: Big East Classic shows 100-plus vintage sleds in Syracuse
summary: The vintage show at the Big East Powersports Show judges more than 100 old sleds across 15 classes at the New York State Fairgrounds.

title: Dillon clinches Snocross Pro title in his rookie season
summary: The 2025–26 season wrapped up at Spirit Mountain in Duluth after 16 rounds, with Lebel second and Benham third overall.

title: Arctic Cat's 2027 lineup brings back Jag, Bearcat, XF and El Tigre
summary: The 2027 sleds revive classic nameplates, add a new Pantera touring lineup and spread electronic power steering deeper into the trail range.

title: Polaris unveils its 2027 snowmobile lineup
summary: New mountain models, wider 9R engine availability and a youth 200, with top-tier models sold only during SnowCheck.

title: Ski-Doo's 2027 lineup debuts the 600RR E-TEC engine
summary: Ski-Doo's 2027 sleds bring a new Rotax 600RR E-TEC two-stroke and a lighter platform, plus updated models and colours.

title: Midwest Ride-In vintage show moves to Dayton, Minnesota
summary: One of the biggest vintage sled gatherings, often called Waconia, moves to Dehn's Pumpkins & Event Center on French Lake for its 35th year.

title: Polaris expands Patriot 650 and 850 clutch recall
summary: About 21,160 Matryx sleds from 2022–2025 with Patriot 650 or 850 engines are covered, including some that already had the first repair. Check your VIN with a Polaris dealer.
